observation.visible_scene: A snow-dusted small-town street at night, the buildings and storefronts (including a brick 'DUMMIE FLORIST' building on the right) outlined with warm string lights. A red SUV is parked at the curb on the right and a dark car is parked on the left; both remain fixed throughout. The camera viewpoint is stationary.
visible_changes: In the early frames a vehicle's headlights appear in the far-left background and steadily brighten as the vehicle approaches down the street toward the camera.
The approaching vehicle resolves into a white/light-colored SUV that grows larger frame-by-frame while moving along the left side of the road.
The white SUV continues forward, its headlights dominating the left-center of the frame, then crosses the foreground from left to right with visible motion blur.
The SUV's rear and taillights pass the right edge and it exits the frame; the street then returns to the static parked-car scene for the remaining frames.
The parked red SUV on the right and the dark car on the left do not change position at any point.
outside_clip_unknowns: The vehicle's origin before the first frame and its destination after leaving the frame are not shown.
Whether additional traffic or pedestrians appear outside this excerpt is unknown.
The cause of the vehicle's motion (driver, traffic state) is not visible.
uncertain_details: Exact speed of the passing SUV is not measurable from the frames.
The early bright points are consistent with the same approaching vehicle's headlights rather than a separate light source, but distant detail is low.
